items.evidence: lib/e/ui/collection.e (D845): table and data_grid over a TableSource (count, key, cell) in the lazy viewport under a header row whose taps report the column to sort, whose drags carry the column as a D844 drop payload for a Reorder, and whose handles report a ColumnResize, rows picking by key and marked from a key selection; tree and outline over a TreeSource (count/key per parent, has_children, build) flattening only the expanded nodes, marks and Left/Right toggling, rows picking, tree items with level and position; tree_table hanging CellSource columns off the tree under the same header; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_tabular on both hosts. (D1096) HeaderRow Alt+Left/Right emits the existing ColumnResize callback in 16px steps, clamped to the pointer handle's minimum; ui_collections2_v2 holds both directions on Windows and Linux. (D1097) HeaderRow Ctrl+Shift+Left/Right emits the existing Reorder operation for an adjacent column and does nothing at the row boundary; ui_collections2_v2 holds movement and the boundary on Windows and Linux. (D1100) Table rows route semantic Press through the same stable-key pick callback as pointer taps; caller-owned DataGrid rows remain non-interactive. ui_collections2_v2 holds it on Windows and Linux. (D1102) TreeItems inherit their first descendant semantic or text label for accessibility and join the runtime's buffered typeahead context over visible focusable rows; ui_collections3_v2 and ui_accessibility hold labels and movement on Windows and Linux. (D1103) Every TreeItem advertises semantic Press and routes it through the same stable-key pick callback as pointer activation while branches retain state-matched Expand or Collapse; ui_collections3_v2 holds the actions on Windows and Linux. (D1104) Tree computes and allocates its exact visible row count instead of truncating at 512, rejecting a source that changes between count and build passes; ui_collections3_v2 holds a 513-row boundary on Windows and Linux. (D1105) Widget semantics, the accessibility tree and both flat host records carry None/Ascending/Descending/Other sort direction; HeaderRow marks its sorted column from descending and ui_collections2_v2 holds one ascending and one descending header on Windows and Linux. (D1106) TreeTable publishes a named TreeGrid with visible row and column counts; its hierarchical items publish as Rows while preserving level, sibling position, actions and buffered typeahead. ui_collections3_v2 and ui_accessibility hold the role path on Windows and Linux. (D1107) Accessibility derives an unnamed data Row's label from its first descendant text while excluding header rows; ui_collections2_v2 and ui_collections3_v2 hold Table and TreeGrid row names on Windows and Linux. (D1108) Every table-family Cell carries its column title as label and derives an empty value from rendered descendant content, producing self-contained host records while row naming and TreeGrid typeahead skip that header wrapper. ui_collections2_v2, ui_collections3_v2 and ui_accessibility pass on Windows and Linux.
